claims.claim: gws gmail helper commands include +send, +reply, +reply-all, +forward, +triage and +watch. Documented in the CLI README (https://github.com/googleworkspace/cli/blob/main/README.md).

Penal Law Section 64 (סעיף 64) lets the Minister of Justice update these ceilings by order, rather than them rising automatically each year.

claims.claim: Section 30A(i)(1) says the court MAY award damages not dependent on harm, up to 1,000 NIS per advertisement, where the advertisement was sent knowingly. A kolzchut summary of the same section (סעיף 30א) is at https://www.kolzchut.org.il/he/פיצוי_בגין_משלוח_דברי_פרסומת_ללא_הסכמה_של_הנמען_(חוק_הספאם) .

claims.claim: The Hebcal REST API gives no single flag or subcat meaning "Israeli day off": minor holidays come back as subcat "minor"; subcat "major" also carries all nine Chanukah days and all ten Chol HaMoed days, which are Israeli working days; fast days appear only with mf=on and four of the five 2026 fasts are working days; modern holidays come back as subcat "modern" mixing Yom HaZikaron and Yom HaAtzma'ut with six working days; and nx=on adds Rosh Chodesh under category "roshchodesh" with no subcat.
claims.raw_snippet: {"title":"Tu BiShvat","date":"2026-02-02","category":"holiday","subcat":"minor"
claims.note: Full 2026 feed enumerated live on 2026-08-19 with maj=on&mf=on&mod=on&i=on: 37 holiday/major (including Chanukah: 1 Candle through Chanukah: 8th Day on 2026-12-04 to 2026-12-12, and ten CH''M entries across Pesach and Sukkot), 5 holiday/fast (Ta'anit Esther, Ta'anit Bechorot, Tzom Tammuz, Tzom Gedaliah, Asara B'Tevet, all working days; Yom Kippur and Tish'a B'Av arrive as major), and 14 holiday/modern (Yom HaZikaron and Yom HaAtzma'ut alongside Hebrew Language Day, Family Day, Yom HaAliyah, Yom HaShoah, Herzl Day, Sigd and others). Separately, 2026-02-02 returns Tu BiShvat as holiday/minor. The documented query yields exactly 20 blocking dates for 2026.
